name: Al-Monitor
text: US Central Command rejected Iran's claim that it had fired a missile at an American F-16 over the Gulf, calling the account false.

name: The Guardian
text: Week-long United Nations talks on regulating autonomous weapons ended without agreeing a mandate for negotiating a binding treaty, with Russia accused of obstructing progress.

name: Middle East Eye
text: Iran has vowed to take any necessary steps to end the US naval blockade.

name: Mehr News
text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they shot down another suspected US reconnaissance drone that entered Iranian airspace over the northern Persian Gulf off Bushehr.

name: Xinhua
text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards have revealed a new missile base and a twin-missile launcher.

name: Le Monde
text: Finnish authorities say a drone struck a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic, setting it on fire, and a Russian helicopter may have entered Finnish airspace hours later.

name: Middle East Eye
text: Trump says he never cared about regime change in Iran.

name: Ukrainska Pravda
text: Finland has acknowledged that Ukrainian drones struck the Russian vessel Sparta II after it drifted into Finnish waters, and it suspects a Russian helicopter entered its airspace.

name: DW
text: Russia struck the hometown of Ukraine's president, killing two people, after Moscow promised a harsh response to Ukrainian attacks on the Kerch Bridge.

name: AP
text: Iran struck three tankers while displaying its missile launchers, amid other Middle East developments.

name: Ukrainska Pravda
text: Zelenskyy said Ukraine requires security guarantees lasting decades rather than only through Trump's time in office, noting no concrete NATO Article 5-style commitments yet.

name: The Guardian
text: Denmark plans to expel a Russian diplomat over suspected Russian intelligence involvement in a plot to kill a US-Ukrainian musician before a Copenhagen concert.

name: Reuters
text: NATO's Rutte stated the alliance will defend all Polish territory.

name: Daily Sabah
text: Trump describes his recent meeting with Xi as a diplomatic win, while analysts argue China has gained the advantage across three high-profile encounters.

name: Kyiv Independent
text: Zelensky said Ukraine has not yet received written commitments on proposed NATO-style security guarantees and still wants clarity on what they would involve.

name: Reuters
text: Russia says a cargo vessel was hit by drones, and Finland reports the ship is on fire in its territorial waters.

name: Ukrainska Pravda
text: Zelenskyy says Ukraine's possible NATO membership is under discussion with France and the US, which he views as the strongest security guarantee.

name: BBC News
text: Ukraine's president says Kyiv's strikes on the Crimean Bridge were a fair reply, made as he met the UK's Streeting, after 109 Russian aerial attacks on Ukrainian bridges.

name: France 24
text: More than 200 former TPLF fighters surrendered to Ethiopia's federal military on Friday as troops mobilised along the Eritrean border amid rising tensions.
